commentary: Despite headline benchmark strength lifting large-cap gauges, divergent midcap and smallcap breadth (breadth score 40, Weak gate) flashes classic Stan Weinstein Stage warning signals. William O'Neil's market-direction discipline mandates defensive posture: large-cap index rallies masking underlying distribution across broader issues require disciplined cash preservation and progressive exposure. Swing traders must avoid chasing low-liquidity beta and demand strict CANSLIM earnings confirmation above rising 30-week moving averages.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Price holds above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, consolidating within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 958.91 on 1.75× volume. Relative strength is improving but lacks prior consolidation tightness.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite strong top-line expansion exceeding 80% YoY, profitability remains deeply negative due to recurring operating losses and negative ROCE (-3.7%), failing O'Neil's bottom-line CANSLIM criteria.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown below the 874.22 stop level violates key moving average support, necessitating an immediate exit.

ABDL.technical: Consolidating near its 20-session pivot at 754.55 with price positioned constructively above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA; RSI at 69 shows robust momentum without overextension.
ABDL.fundamental: Operates with 18.4% ROCE and 14.3% ROE, but recent quarterly earnings contracted by 47.9% YoY alongside negative top-line growth, failing CANSLIM's current earnings acceleration test.
ABDL.risk: Failure to breach 754.55 and a breakdown beneath 687.01 invalidates the pivot structure, forcing an automatic loss cut.

ADVANCE.technical: Classic Stage 2 breakout through 20-day and 52-week highs on explosive 7.66× volume; neatly stacked above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with strong relative strength.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM profile with triple-digit EPS growth (+152.2% YoY), 95.9% revenue surge, 28% ROCE, and 29.1% ROE supported by strong seasonal agrochemical demand.
ADVANCE.risk: A close below the 134.56 stop level voids the breakout pivot; cut loss immediately.

AEGISLOG.technical: Forms a textbook double bottom base above all key moving averages; breakout attempt supported by massive 4.64× volume and healthy RSI at 57.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary fundamentals with Q1 PAT up 212% YoY, revenue up 37.1%, and expanding LPG margins to ₹7,000/ton, supported by a solid 16.3% ROE.
AEGISLOG.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 1379.53 double-bottom swing support.

AEROENTER.technical: Constructing a double bottom base above its 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA; MACD positive and volume registering 1.48× average, though overhead supply looms near 160.
AEROENTER.fundamental: While reported net profit surged, gains were largely driven by non-core other income (₹144 Cr vs ₹17 Cr core operating profit), keeping core ROCE and ROE depressed near ~3%.
AEROENTER.risk: Close below 145.36 breaches the base structure; execute stop-loss without hesitation.

ANUHPHR.technical: Emerging from a double bottom base testing the 99.60 neckline on 3.28× volume; comfortably positioned above rising 50, 150, and 200 DMAs.
ANUHPHR.fundamental: Virtually debt-free bulk API manufacturer with healthy 14.9% ROCE; latest EPS grew 37.6% YoY, but top-line growth of 3.93% falls short of CANSLIM's 15% threshold.
ANUHPHR.risk: Break below the 91.54 support invalidates the neckline base and demands risk reduction.
